The hamster is facing left, with its head partially obscured by the structure's edge. Its body is stocky and covered in dense, short golden-brown fur, transitioning to pinkish skin on the visible hind leg and lower belly. One hind leg is clearly visible, showing small digits. The background consists of beige textured surfaces, likely cardboard or plastic walls of a cage.
